rationale: Both independently zero in on the same core weak spot the ground truth flags (lookup_model_spec's fragile component-based regex matching), with X demonstrating a concrete repro table (a real, still-live edge case) and Y describing it more generically but correctly; the literal ground-truth scenario (demo paths failing) is actually already fixed in this final diff, so neither fully 'recalls' it verbatim. X is deeper and more actionable (severity tiers, verdict, literal code patches, H3-recipe-informed findings like num_frames/duration and audio re-encoding) but contains one clearly incorrect claim (image_2/audio_2 'always raise' is false — audio_2 paired with image_1 works) and leans on files outside the diff that can't be verified here. Y is more mechanical/dense but every core finding is tightly grounded in quoted diff lines with no detected errors, and it catches two things X misses (fps=8 test mismatch vs H3's fixed-24 requirement, missing VALIDATE_INPUTS on the new VideoReferences node). The strengths largely offset.
